source_says.explanation: Section 3.1 describes 200 people as recruited, with 50 per group, and Table 2 explicitly reports 50 participants in each demographic group. However, Appendix A.2 reports 29 workers filtered out and describes one SELF participant whose completed work was excluded after a post-hoc writing-pattern check. The PDF does not explicitly say whether the 200 and four counts of 50 precede or follow all these exclusions, describe replacement recruitment, or provide an enrollment-to-analysis flow reconciling them. The SELF participant's incentive arm is unspecified. Thus 200 and 50 per arm are reported sample counts, but their coding as exact post-exclusion analysis denominators is not explicitly established. This is an unresolved denominator issue, not evidence for a particular alternative total; neither subtraction nor addition of exclusions yields a confirmed replacement count.

problems.quote: In all, the strategies we employed are quite conservative, and we managed to filter out 29 Prolific workers.
problems.locator: PDF p. 3, Section 3.1, recruitment paragraph; p. 5, Table 2 and caption; pp. 20 and 25, Appendix A.2, especially Post-hoc strategies and the following paragraph.

confirmed.statement: The paper reports one between-subjects experiment, with participants block-randomized to four cells crossing AI access (AI/SELF) and incentives (O/T).

The reported recruitment count is 200 people; Table 2 explicitly reports 50 participants in each of AI-O, SELF-O, AI-T and SELF-T. These numbers are present in the source, although their post-exclusion status is unresolved.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 3, Section 3.1; p. 5, Table 2 and caption.

confirmed.statement: The counts refer to human Prolific participants. The paper separately distinguishes 100 AI participants from their 357 queries and defines a participant-level similarity score by averaging comparisons with other participants.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 5, AI Usage; p. 6, Section 4.1.1 and the participant-level outcome formula.

confirmed.statement: Appendix A.2 reports 29 workers filtered out and describes one paid SELF participant excluded after a post-hoc writing-pattern check; it does not identify that person as SELF-O or SELF-T or provide a complete exclusion breakdown.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 25, Appendix A.2, Post-hoc strategies and the following paragraph.

confirmed.statement: Five full-screen/window violations or six inactivity warnings terminate participation and exclude the submission; instruction and prompt attention-check failures also terminate sessions. A terminated participant ID cannot restart.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 20, Appendix A.2, Global strategies and attention mechanism; p. 25, Window-specific strategies.

confirmed.statement: The 11 submissions outside the word limit were retained in the final analysis.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 20, Appendix A.1.4, final paragraph.

confirmed.statement: The total and per-arm numbers randomized before all exclusions are not explicitly reconciled in a participant flow; the form appropriately leaves n_randomized null.
confirmed.locator: PDF pp. 3-5, Section 3; p. 18, Appendix A.1.1; pp. 20 and 25, Appendix A.2; full-document review, pp. 1-30.

confirmed.statement: Table 4 reports 27 high-adoption and 37 low-adoption participants. Appendix C.3 defines disjoint groups (adoption above 0.8 versus below 0.2), and Section 6.2/Table 6 analyze their final submissions within this experiment. Therefore 27 + 37 = 64 distinct analyzed people is a directly supported lower bound, sufficient for criterion 2 without assuming the exact full-sample denominator.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 11, Section 6.2, Adoption as a driver for diversity; p. 13, Table 4 column headers; p. 28, Appendix C.3; p. 30, Table 6 and caption.

confirmed.statement: First AI drafts, repeated drafts, temporal snapshots and adoption strata reuse participants from the same experiment. Only 91% of the 100 AI participants requested a full draft, 23 requested at least three drafts, and trajectory analyses include only snapshots with at least 200 words; these are subsets or repeated observations, not additional independent people or studies.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 5, AI Usage; pp. 8-9, Sections 5.1-5.2 and Figure 2; pp. 27-29, Appendix C.2 and Figures 15-17.

confirmed.statement: The participant eligibility description matches the source: US or UK residence, English primary language or fluency, age at least 18, at least 500 completed Prolific tasks, and at least 98% historical approval.

No second independently recruited study or reuse of another paper's participant sample is stated in the saved document. Cross-paper overlap remains unverified; the blank overlap field is not proof that overlap is absent.
confirmed.locator: PDF pp. 2-3, Related Work; pp. 3-5, Experiment Design and Data; p. 14, Section 7.2; pp. 18-30, Appendices A-C; full-document review.

summary: The reported 200 participants and 50 per arm are not explicitly reconciled with 29 exclusions, so the exact post-exclusion analyzed counts remain unconfirmed. Criterion 2 still holds: the same randomized study documents 27 high-adoption and 37 low-adoption participants, establishing at least 64 distinct people analyzed.
